\n

\n \n 1\n \n Front yard setback shall be measured from the face of the garage to the face of the\n sidewalk, allowing for 20' of parking on the driveway without overhang onto the sidewalk.\n

\n

\n \n 2\n \n Zero-Lot-Line, reduced street side yard setbacks and reduced front and rear setback\n waivers may be requested through the Development Agreement process. All other side\n yard setback requests for detached structures shall not be granted waivers, unless\n approved by Council as part of a Planned Unit Development.\n

\n

\n \n 3\n \n All setbacks in the CBD, C-1. C-2, LO, IL, PS, RC and M-U zone shall maintain a minimum\n 15' when adjacent to a residential use or zone. A waiver may be requested if thee\n adjacent property has the potential to redevelop as a non-residential use in the future.\n

\n

\n \n 4\n \n As approved by the Fire District.\n

\n

\n \n 5\n \n 35' height requirement unless a height exception is approved by Council through the\n Conditional Use Permit or Planned Unit Development Process.\n

\n

\n Note Conditions:\n \n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Minimum Property Size:\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 1.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Each property shall be of sufficient size to meet the minimum setbacks as established\n in this section.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 2.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Minimum property size shall be determined exclusive of land that is used for the conveyance\n of irrigation water, drainage, creek or river flows unless: a) the water is conveyed\n through pipe or tile; and b) included as part of a utility easement that generally\n runs along the property lines.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 3.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n When two (2) or more parcels of land, each of which is of inadequate area and dimension\n to qualify for a permitted use under the requirements of the district in which the\n parcels are located, are held in one ownership, they shall be used as one property\n for such use.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Minimum Street Frontage:\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 1.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Properties with street frontages on cul-de-sacs or at approximately a ninety-degree\n (90°) angle shall be a minimum of twenty feet (20') measured as a chord measurement.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 2.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Street knuckles shall be separated from through traffic by a landscape island. Properties\n with frontages on such knuckles shall be a minimum of twenty feet (20') measured as\n a chord measurement.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 3.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n All other properties with street frontage shall have a minimum of thirty-five feet\n (35').\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n C.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Additional Setback Criteria:\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 1.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Chimneys, pop out windows, direct vent gas fireplaces, entertainment centers, window\n seats and other projections which do not increase the usable floor area and do not\n exceed eight feet (8') in width may project up to two feet (2') into any required\n setback, provided that projections that are at finished grade, including, but not\n limited to, chimneys and fireplaces, do not encroach within a side yard utility easement.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 2.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n One detached accessory building that is less than two hundred (200) square feet in\n area and nine feet (9') or less in height shall be allowed in the required rear yard.\n In no case shall an accessory building be allowed in the street yard or the required\n side yard.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 3.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Accessory structures, such as decks and patios, which are one foot (1') or less in\n height, as measured from the property's finished grade, may occupy any yard area.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 4.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n In all residential zones garages and carports opening onto a side street must have\n a minimum distance between the opening of such garage or carport and the side street\n lot line of not less than twenty feet (20').\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 5.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Front yard setback from arterial and collector streets (as identified on the highway\n district functional classification map) is 30 feet in all residential zoning districts.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 6.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Street side setback on arterial and collector streets (as identified on the highway\n district functional classification map) is 20 feet in all residential zoning districts.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 7.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Setback areas are subject to drainage compliance or otherwise specified within this\n title.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 8.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n If a Planned Unit Development is approved, waivers to setbacks may be permitted if\n determined by the council to be appropriate for the development and that such waivers\n will be compatible with the area and shall meet emergency service requirements.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 9.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Building eaves may project up to two feet (2') into any required setback.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 10.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Patio covers may project to within 10' of the rear yard setback provided that posts\n or foundations are not located within the required setback, and utility easements\n are not encroached upon.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n D.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Maximum Height Limit:\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 1.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Height exceptions shall not be permitted except by discretion of the council with\n the submittal of a conditional use permit or development agreement application.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 2.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n The maximum height limitations shall not apply to the following architectural features,\n not intended for human occupation: spire or steeple, belfry, cupola, chimney. Such\n architectural features shall have a maximum height limit of twenty feet (20'), as\n measured from the roofline.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 3.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n The maximum height limitations shall not apply to the following: amateur radio antenna;\n bridge tower; fire and hose tower; observation tower; power line tower; smokestack;\n water tank or tower; ventilator; windmill; wireless communication facility, or other\n commercial or personal tower and/or antenna structure; or other appurtenances usually\n required to be placed above the level of the ground and not intended for human occupancy.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 4.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n No exception shall be allowed to the height limit where the height of any structures\n will constitute a hazard to the safe landing and takeoff of aircraft in an established\n airport.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n E.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n All new residential and accessory structures over two hundred (200) square feet within\n any zoning district shall comply with residential setbacks. Accessory structures less\n than two hundred (200) square feet shall not intrude on the primary structures required\n side yard setback.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n F.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Spite strips, common lots, unreasonable development phasing, or other means of any\n type purposely or unintentional that may result in the blocking of services or development,\n including but not limited to sewer, water, streets, or utilities are prohibited in\n any zoning district within the City of Star.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n (Ord. 303, 2-11-2020; amd. Ord. 310, 7-21-2020; Repealed & Replaced by Ord. 370-2022 on 7/19/2022; Amended by Ord. 404-2024 on 6/18/2024)\n
